glosses: detour (a diversion or deviation from one's original route)
an instance of talking around or circumventing
rodeo (North American sport involving skills with horses, cows and other livestock)

examples.en: Let's not beat around the bush.

examples.text: Para decirlo sin rodeos, él está equivocado.
examples.en: To put it bluntly, he's mistaken.

examples.text: Le pregunté sin andarme con rodeos.
Deja de dar rodeos y ve al grano.
examples.en: Stop beating around the bush and get to the point.
